summary: Verified new inline-edit Sample-name feature on /history plus full regression. Backend: 19/19 pytest passed including 6 new PATCH tests (simple rename preserves rating/category/created_at/notes/confidence/image_data, empty string clears + persists, unicode 'Sampel Ω-α β 中文 🧪', 500-char long string, /api/analyses?q= search matches new sample_name after edit, 404 on unknown id). Frontend Playwright on a freshly created TEST_ record verified: (1) sample-edit-trigger-{id} exists, click enters edit mode, sample-edit-input-{id} auto-focused with value pre-selected. (2) Enter commits + optimistic cell update; PATCH persists (verified via GET). (3) Escape discards. (4) sample-edit-save-{id} (green check) commits. (5) sample-edit-cancel-{id} (gray X) discards. (6) Empty string commit shows '— add name' placeholder & backend stored ''. (7) Unicode round-trip works. (8) Unchanged value on Enter fires NO PATCH request (verified via page.on('request')). (9) onBlur commits changed value. (10) After page reload, edited name persists. (11) Search q= matches edited sample_name. (12) Regression: view-btn/pdf-btn/delete-btn all present, detail dialog opens. No console errors, no 'Converting circular structure' errors. Accuracy prompt untouched: COLOR-ACCURACY PROTOCOL still present in server.py and ASTM_REFERENCE_IMAGE_B64 non-empty.
critical_code_review_comments: EditableSampleCell uses onMouseDown (with preventDefault) on save/cancel buttons to fire BEFORE the Input's onBlur — this is the correct pattern to avoid the blur-then-click race. Nice.
commit() compares trimmed next vs trimmed original before firing PATCH, so 'no PATCH when unchanged' semantics are enforced client-side (verified in test).
Optimistic update in updateSampleName trims and sets local state, then PATCHes; on failure it re-fetches. Good UX.
Minor: sample-edit-input has max-width 260px; very long names (>~30 chars) are truncated visually while editing. Not a bug, just cosmetic.
Minor: consider adding aria-label on the pencil/check/x buttons for better a11y (currently rely on title attribute).
seed_data_creation: One TEST_ record created via /api/analyze and deleted at end of Playwright run. All PATCH pytest fixtures also auto-cleanup. Real user data (wz 260393, wz 25890, wz 267658, wl26078891) not touched.
